title: POST /api/projects/:id/parking-lot — add parking lot item
description: Create a new parking lot idea for a project.
acceptanceCriteria: POST requires auth and project ownership

steps.details: createParkingLotSchema = z.object({ title: z.string().min(1).max(500), description: z.string().max(2000).optional() }). Insert into parking_lot_items. Return 201.
POST new item — verify 201 with correct fields. POST with empty title — expect 400.
